name: Benjamin West
contribution: An American-born British painter who specialised in history painting, creating such works as The Death of Nelson, The Death of General Wolfe, the Treaty of Paris, and Benjamin Franklin Drawing Electricity from the Sky.
legacy: He impressed King George III and was largely responsible for the launch of the Royal Academy, of which he became the second president.

death: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland

checks.lead: Benjamin West  (10 October 1738 – 11 March 1820) was an American-born British painter who specialised in history painting, creating such works as The Death of Nelson, The Death of General Wolfe, the Treaty of Paris, and Benjamin Franklin Drawing Electricity from the Sky.
